# CANDIDATE: MIDDAY_STRUCTURE_PULLBACK_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

In an established intraday uptrend (HH/HL), a pullback to the short‑term EMA with modest RSI offers a low‑risk continuation entry. This edge exists because during midday, after the initial morning volatility, trends often resume with pullbacks to dynamic support (EMA) providing asymmetric risk-reward.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: After 11:00 EST, if the last 5 bars contain a higher high (HH) and higher low (HL) confirming an uptrend, and price touches or crosses the 20‑EMA with RSI between 30 and 45, enter long at the close of that bar. Exit shape: Chart‑stop at the most recent higher low (HL), TP1 at the prior higher high (HH), runner trail 10% off high‑water mark. Regime hint: Ideal when VIX is between 15‑25 and time is 11:00‑14:00 EST (midday trend‑pullback window).
